Proxima will give me an extra portion for this.''"
"''Well, I think she's going to give that extra portion to me.|One of the younger scrumrats is robbed by Lexi|}} '''Lexi''', also known as just '''Lex''', was a [[human]] [[Gender|female]] who served as a [[scrumrat]] for the [[White Worms]] gang on the [[planet]] [[Corellia]]. In [[13 BBY]], she snatched a piece of stolen loot from one of the younger scrumrats to give to [[Lady]] [[Proxima]], leader of the gang, herself. ==Biography== {{Quote|It belongs to whoever's holding it.''"
"''And that's not you.|A young female scrumrat and Lexi|}} Lexi was a [[human]] [[Gender|girl]] who lived on the [[planet]] [[Corellia]] and became a member of the criminal [[White Worms]] gang at a young age. She served the gang's leader, [[Lady]] [[Proxima]], as a [[scrumrat]] and worked out of the [[Den of the White Worms]] along with the other members of the group. In [[13 BBY]], she and three other scrumrats returned to the tunnels around the den together and emptied their [[backpack]]s to compare the loot they had stolen. A younger scrumrat showed her a a shiny piece of stolen material that he believed Proxima would give him and entire [[Foodstuff|portion]] for; however, Lexi snatched it and claimed that she would be the one to get the portion. The boy complained and tried to grab the stolen property back, but Lexi escaped with it, so he gave chase. The older scrumrat [[Han Solo]] witnessed the cruel theft, but did not intervene as he believed the boy needed to learn to fend for himself.''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story: Expanded Edition]]'' ==Personality and traits== Lexi was cruel enough to steal from another scrumrat and potentially deprive him of his dinner. She had fair skin, [[Color|red]] [[hair]], and brown [[eye]]s. ==Equipment== Lexi wore brown [[Clothing|robes]] with a [[scarf]] and a satchel for carrying stolen goods. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|Look what I got. I bet Lady Proxima'll give me an extra portion for this!''"
"''No, no, she's gonna give that extra portion to me, now!''"
"''No fair, give it back!|The young scrumrat and Lexi's dialogue in the novelization|}} Lexi was portrayed by [[Lily Newmark]] in the [[2018]] [[Star Wars Anthology Series|Anthology film]], ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''. Her dialogue is slightly abbreviated in the [[Solo: A Star Wars Story: Expanded Edition|novelization]] of the film written by [[Mur Lafferty]]. ==Appearances== *''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]'' {{1st}} *''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story: Expanded Edition]]'' {{Ab|Solo: A Star Wars Story: Expanded Edition (audiobook)}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |fr=Lexi |ja=レクシー（スクラムラット） |ka=ლექსი }} [[Category:Females]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Scrumrats]]
